# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks for redundant parentheses.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   (x) if ((y.z).nil?)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x if y.z.nil?
      #
      class RedundantParentheses < Base
        include Parentheses
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        def self.apply_parentheses_correction(corrector, node)
          new_parentheses_coordinator.send(:apply_parentheses_correction, corrector, node)
        end

        def self.handle_ternary_parentheses_for(cop, node)
          new_parentheses_coordinator.send(:handle_ternary_parentheses, cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_grouped_expression_for(cop, node)
          new_parentheses_coordinator.send(:handle_grouped_expression, cop, node)
        end

        def self.new_parentheses_coordinator
          instance = allocate
          instance.send(:boot_parentheses_coordinator)
          instance
        end

        private

        def boot_parentheses_coordinator
          @parentheses_correction_state = {}
          @ternary_parentheses_state = {}
          @grouped_expression_state = {}
          @method_call_parentheses_state = {}
        end

        def apply_parentheses_correction(corrector, node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:node] = node
          @parentheses_correction_state[:source] = node&.source
          return unless corrector && node
          profile = profile_parentheses_correction_target(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:profile] = profile
          record_parentheses_correction_context(node)
          remove_redundant_parentheses_tokens(corrector, node)
          handle_orphaned_comma_after_parentheses(corrector, node)
          return unless ternary_condition_parentheses?(node) && question_mark_follows_parentheses?(node)
          corrector.insert_after(node.loc.end, ' ')
        end

        def record_parentheses_correction_context(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:context] = node&.type
          @parentheses_correction_state[:balanced] = balanced_parentheses_locations?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:span] = parentheses_source_span(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:single_child] = parentheses_single_child?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:empty_group] = parentheses_empty_group?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:chained] = parentheses_chained_begin?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:parent_send] = parentheses_parent_send?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:parent_block] = parentheses_parent_block?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:hash_pair] = parentheses_inside_hash_pair?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:array] = parentheses_inside_array?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:interpolation] = parentheses_inside_interpolation?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:layout] = capture_parentheses_layout_context(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:space] = correction_requires_space_after_end?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:comma] = correction_requires_comma_cleanup?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:heredoc] = correction_requires_heredoc_adjustment?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:begin_token] = parentheses_begin_token?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:end_token] = parentheses_end_token?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:child_count] = parentheses_child_count(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:summary] = summarize_parentheses_correction(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:full] = describe_full_expression(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:letter_before] = letter_before_begin?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:letter_after] = letter_after_end?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:keyword_arg] = inside_keyword_argument?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:do_end_chain] = begin_wraps_do_end_chain?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:brace_chain] = begin_wraps_brace_chain?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:catalog] = catalog_any_expression(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:call_profile] = profile_method_call_parentheses(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state
        end

        def profile_parentheses_correction_target(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:profile_type] = node&.type
          return empty_parentheses_profile unless node
          children = node.respond_to?(:child_nodes) ? node.child_nodes : node.children
          last_child = children.respond_to?(:last) ? children.last : nil
          {
            type: node.type,
            begin_loc: node.loc.respond_to?(:begin) ? node.loc.begin : nil,
            end_loc: node.loc.respond_to?(:end) ? node.loc.end : nil,
            ternary_parent: ternary_condition_parentheses?(node),
            heredoc: parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node),
            comma_line: closing_paren_before_comma?(node),
            last_child_type: last_child.respond_to?(:type) ? last_child.type : nil,
            expression: inspect_expression_node(node)
          }
        end

        def remove_redundant_parentheses_tokens(corrector, node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:removed] = true
          return unless corrector && node && node.loc
          begin_loc = node.loc.begin
          end_loc = node.loc.end
          corrector.remove(begin_loc) if begin_loc
          corrector.remove(end_loc) if end_loc
        end

        def handle_orphaned_comma_after_parentheses(corrector, node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:comma_checked] = true
          return unless closing_paren_before_comma?(node)
          range = extend_range_for_parentheses_heredoc(node, surrounding_parentheses_range(node))
          corrector.remove(range)
          restore_heredoc_comma_after_parentheses(corrector, node)
        end

        def closing_paren_before_comma?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:comma_line] = node&.loc.respond_to?(:end) ? node.loc.end&.line : nil
          return false unless node&.loc.respond_to?(:end) && node.loc.end
          source_buffer = node.source_range.source_buffer
          line_range = source_buffer.line_range(node.loc.end.line)
          line_range.source.start_with?(/\s*\)\s*,/)
        end

        def surrounding_parentheses_range(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:range_side] = :left
          range_with_surrounding_space(
            range: node.loc.end,
            buffer: node.source_range.source_buffer,
            side: :left,
            newlines: true,
            whitespace: true,
            continuations: true
          )
        end

        def extend_range_for_parentheses_heredoc(node, range)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:heredoc_extend] = parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node)
          return range unless parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node)
          comma_line = range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, buffer: node.source_range.source_buffer)
          match = comma_line.source.match(/(?<=\))\s*,/)
          offset = match && match[0] ? match[0].size : 0
          range.adjust(end_pos: offset)
        end

        def restore_heredoc_comma_after_parentheses(corrector, node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:heredoc_comma] = parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node)
          return unless parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node)
          corrector.insert_after(node.child_nodes.last, ',')
        end

        def parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:heredoc] = node&.type
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:child_nodes)
          last = node.child_nodes.last
          return false unless last && last.loc
          last.loc.is_a?(Parser::Source::Map::Heredoc)
        end

        def ternary_condition_parentheses?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:ternary_parent] = node&.parent&.type
          parent = node&.parent
          return false unless parent
          parent.if_type? && parent.ternary?
        end

        def question_mark_follows_parentheses?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:question_column] = node&.parent&.loc.respond_to?(:question) ? node.parent.loc.question&.column : nil
          return false unless node&.loc.respond_to?(:last_column)
          return false unless node.parent&.loc.respond_to?(:question) && node.parent.loc.question
          node.loc.last_column == node.parent.loc.question.column
        end

        def empty_parentheses_profile
          @parentheses_correction_state[:empty_profile] = true
          { type: :empty, begin_loc: nil, end_loc: nil, ternary_parent: false, heredoc: false, comma_line: false }
        end

        def correction_requires_space_after_end?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:space_after] = node&.type
          ternary_condition_parentheses?(node) && question_mark_follows_parentheses?(node)
        end

        def correction_requires_comma_cleanup?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:comma_cleanup] = node&.type
          closing_paren_before_comma?(node)
        end

        def correction_requires_heredoc_adjustment?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:heredoc_adjust] = node&.type
          parentheses_wrap_heredoc?(node)
        end

        def summarize_parentheses_correction(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:summary] = node&.type
          {
            space: correction_requires_space_after_end?(node),
            comma: correction_requires_comma_cleanup?(node),
            heredoc: correction_requires_heredoc_adjustment?(node),
            profile: profile_parentheses_correction_target(node)
          }
        end

        def parentheses_begin_token?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:begin_token] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          return false unless loc.respond_to?(:begin)
          !loc.begin.nil? && loc.begin.is?('(')
        end

        def parentheses_end_token?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:end_token] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          return false unless loc.respond_to?(:end)
          !loc.end.nil? && loc.end.is?(')')
        end

        def balanced_parentheses_locations?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:balanced] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          parentheses_begin_token?(node) && parentheses_end_token?(node)
        end

        def parentheses_single_child?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:single_child] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          children.size == 1
        end

        def parentheses_empty_group?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:empty_group] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          node.begin_type? && children.empty?
        end

        def parentheses_chained_begin?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:chained_begin] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          node.respond_to?(:chained?) && node.chained?
        end

        def parentheses_parent_send?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:parent_send] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          %i[send csend].include?(parent&.type)
        end

        def parentheses_parent_block?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:parent_block] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          %i[block numblock].include?(parent&.type)
        end

        def parentheses_inside_hash_pair?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:hash_pair] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          ancestor = parent
          found = false
          while ancestor && !found
            found = ancestor.pair_type? || ancestor.hash_type?
            ancestor = ancestor.parent

          found

        def parentheses_inside_array?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:array_parent] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc
          child = children.first

          ancestor = parent
          found = false
          while ancestor && !found
            found = ancestor.array_type?
            ancestor = ancestor.parent

        def parentheses_inside_interpolation?(node)
          @parentheses_correction_state[:interpolation] = node&.type
          return false unless node
          type = node.type
          parent = node.parent
          children = node.children
          source = node.source
          multiline = node.multiline?
          loc = node.loc

          ancestor = parent

          return false unless condition.respond_to?(:parenthesized_call?) && condition.parenthesized_call?
          return false unless (first_child = condition.children.first)

        def ternary_parentheses_offense?(cop, node)
          @ternary_parentheses_state[:offense_node] = node&.type
          condition = node.condition
          snapshot = inspect_ternary_condition_tree(condition)
          @ternary_parentheses_state[:snapshot] = snapshot
          if cop.send(:safe_assignment?, condition)
            !cop.send(:safe_assignment_allowed?)
          else
            parens = ternary_parenthesized_condition?(condition)
            style = cop.send(:style)
            if style == :require_parentheses_when_complex
              snapshot[:complex] ? !parens : parens
            else
              style == :require_parentheses ? !parens : parens
            end
          end
        end

        def inspect_ternary_condition_tree(condition)
          @ternary_parentheses_state[:tree_type] = condition&.type
          return { complex: false, empty: true } unless condition
          if condition.begin_type?
            nested = condition.to_a.map { |child| inspect_ternary_condition_tree(child) }
            { complex: nested.any? { |item| item[:complex] }, children: nested, type: :begin }
          else
            { complex: !ternary_non_complex_expression?(condition), type: condition.type }
          end
        end

        def ternary_non_complex_expression?(condition)
          @ternary_parentheses_state[:non_complex_type] = condition&.type
          return false unless condition
          type = condition.type

            true
          elsif type == :const || type == :defined? || type == :yield

             (cop.send(:safe_assignment?, condition) || ternary_unsafe_autocorrect?(condition))
            return
          end
          if ternary_parenthesized_condition?(condition)
            correct_parenthesized_ternary_condition(cop, corrector, condition)

        def ternary_below_precedence?(child)
          @ternary_parentheses_state[:below_precedence] = child.class.name
          return false unless child.respond_to?(:or_type?)
          semantic_or = child.or_type? && child.semantic_operator?
          semantic_and = child.and_type? && child.semantic_operator?
          prefix_not = child.send_type? && child.prefix_not?

        def correct_parenthesized_ternary_condition(cop, corrector, condition)

          corrector.remove(condition.loc.end)
          corrector.insert_after(condition.loc.end, ' ') unless ternary_whitespace_after?(cop, condition)
          send_node = condition.child_nodes.last

          node.operator_method? || node.setter_method? || grouped_chained_calls?(node) ||

          first_argument.call_type? && (node.children.last&.children&.count || 0) > 1

        def grouped_spaces_before_left_parenthesis(node)
          @grouped_expression_state[:space_length] = node&.type
          receiver = node.receiver
          receiver_length = receiver ? receiver.source.length : 0
          without_receiver = node.source[receiver_length..]
          method_regexp = Regexp.escape(node.method_name)
          match = without_receiver.match(/^\s*&?\.?\s*#{method_regexp}(\s+)\(/)
          match ? match.captures[0].length : 0
        end

        def grouped_space_range(expr, space_length)
          @grouped_expression_state[:space_range] = space_length
          Parser::Source::Range.new(expr.source_buffer, expr.begin_pos - space_length, expr.begin_pos)
        end

        def grouped_keyword_operator_argument?(first_arg)

        public


        ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[and or send splat kwsplat].freeze

        # @!method square_brackets?(node)
        def_node_matcher :square_brackets?, '(send {(send _recv _msg) str array hash} :[] ...)'

        # @!method method_node_and_args(node)
        def_node_matcher :method_node_and_args, '$(call _recv _msg $...)'

        # @!method rescue?(node)
        def_node_matcher :rescue?, '{^resbody ^^resbody}'

        # @!method allowed_pin_operator?(node)
        def_node_matcher :allowed_pin_operator?, '^(pin (begin !{lvar ivar cvar gvar}))'

        # @!method arg_in_call_with_block?(node)
        def_node_matcher :arg_in_call_with_block?, '^^(block (send _ _ equal?(%0) ...) ...)'

        def on_begin(node)
          return if !parentheses?(node) || parens_allowed?(node) || ignore_syntax?(node)

          check(node)
        end

        private

        def parens_allowed?(node)
          empty_parentheses?(node) ||
            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node)
        end

        def ignore_syntax?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.while_post_type? || parent.until_post_type? || parent.match_with_lvasgn_type? ||
            like_method_argument_parentheses?(parent) || multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
        end

        def allowed_expression?(node)
          allowed_ancestor?(node) ||
            allowed_method_call?(node) ||
            allowed_multiple_expression?(node) ||
            allowed_ternary?(node) ||
            node.parent&.range_type?
        end

        def allowed_ancestor?(node)
          # Don't flag `break(1)`, etc
          keyword_ancestor?(node) && parens_required?(node)
        end

        def allowed_method_call?(node)
          # Don't flag `method (arg) { }`
          arg_in_call_with_block?(node) && !parentheses?(node.parent)
        end

        def allowed_multiple_expression?(node)
          return false if node.children.one?

          ancestor = node.ancestors.first
          return false unless ancestor

          !ancestor.begin_type? && !ancestor.def_type? && !ancestor.block_type?
        end

        def allowed_ternary?(node)
          return false unless node&.parent&.if_type?

          node.parent.ternary? && ternary_parentheses_required?
        end

        def ternary_parentheses_required?
          config = @config.for_cop('Style/TernaryParentheses')
          allowed_styles = %w[require_parentheses require_parentheses_when_complex]

          config.fetch('Enabled') && allowed_styles.include?(config['EnforcedStyle'])
        end

        def like_method_argument_parentheses?(node)
          return false if !node.send_type? && !node.super_type? && !node.yield_type?

          node.arguments.one? && !node.parenthesized? &&
            !node.arithmetic_operation? && node.first_argument.begin_type?
        end

        def multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)
          return false if parent.single_line?

          parent.return_type? || parent.next_type? || parent.break_type?
        end

        def empty_parentheses?(node)
          # Don't flag `()`
          node.children.empty?
        end

        def first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node)
          # Don't flag `method ({key: value})` or `method ({key: value}.method)`
          hash_literal = method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
          if (root_method = node.each_ancestor(:send).to_a.last)
            parenthesized = root_method.parenthesized_call?
          end
          hash_literal && first_argument?(node) && !parentheses?(hash_literal) && !parenthesized
        end

        def method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node)
          return if node.nil?
          return node if node.hash_type?
          return unless node.send_type?

          method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
        end

        def check(begin_node)
          node = begin_node.children.first

          if (message = find_offense_message(begin_node, node))
            return offense(begin_node, message)
          end

          check_send(begin_node, node) if node.call_type?
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offense_message(begin_node, node)
          return 'a keyword' if keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return 'a literal' if disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          return 'a variable' if node.variable?
          return 'a constant' if node.const_type?
          if node.lambda_or_proc? && (node.braces? || node.send_node.lambda_literal?)
            return 'an expression'
          end
          return 'an interpolated expression' if interpolation?(begin_node)

          return if begin_node.chained?

          if node.and_type? || node.or_type?
            return if node.semantic_operator? && begin_node.parent
            return if node.multiline? && allow_in_multiline_conditions?
            return if ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES.include?(begin_node.parent&.type)
            return if begin_node.parent&.if_type? && begin_node.parent.ternary?

            'a logical expression'
          elsif node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?
            return unless begin_node.parent.nil?

            'a comparison expression'
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        # @!method interpolation?(node)
        def_node_matcher :interpolation?, '[^begin ^^dstr]'

        def allow_in_multiline_conditions?
          parentheses_around_condition_config = config.for_cop('Style/ParenthesesAroundCondition')
          return false unless parentheses_around_condition_config['Enabled']

          !!parentheses_around_condition_config['AllowInMultilineConditions']
        end

        def check_send(begin_node, node)
          return check_unary(begin_node, node) if node.unary_operation?

          return unless method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return if call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, node)

          offense(begin_node, 'a method call')
        end

        def check_unary(begin_node, node)
          return if begin_node.chained?

          node = node.children.first while suspect_unary?(node)

          return if node.send_type? && !method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)

          offense(begin_node, 'a unary operation')
        end

        def offense(node, msg)
          add_offense(node, message: "Don't use parentheses around #{msg}.") do |corrector|
            ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, node)
          end
        end

        def suspect_unary?(node)
          node.send_type? && node.unary_operation? && !node.prefix_not?
        end

        def keyword_ancestor?(node)
          node.parent&.keyword?
        end

        def disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          node.literal? && !node.range_type? && !raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
        end

        def raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
          return false unless node.numeric_type?

          next_sibling = begin_node.right_sibling
          return false unless next_sibling

          base_value = node.children.first

          base_value.negative? && next_sibling == :**
        end

        def keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return false unless node.keyword?
          return true if node.special_keyword?

          args = *node

          if only_begin_arg?(args)
            parentheses?(args.first)
          else
            args.empty? || parentheses?(node)
          end
        end

        def method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return false unless node.call_type?
          return false if node.prefix_not?

          send_node, args = method_node_and_args(node)

          args.empty? || parentheses?(send_node) || square_brackets?(send_node)
        end

        def only_begin_arg?(args)
          args.one? && args.first.begin_type?
        end

        def first_argument?(node)
          if first_send_argument?(node) ||
             first_super_argument?(node) ||
             first_yield_argument?(node)
            return true
          end

          node.each_ancestor.any? { |ancestor| first_argument?(ancestor) }
        end

        # @!method first_send_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_send_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(send _ _ equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_super_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_super_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(super equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_yield_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_yield_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(yield equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        def call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, send_node)
          recv = first_part_of_call_chain(send_node)
          recv&.int_type? && (parent = begin_node.parent) &&
            parent.send_type? && (parent.method?(:-@) || parent.method?(:+@))
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks for redundant parentheses.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   (x) if ((y.z).nil?)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x if y.z.nil?
      #
      class RedundantParentheses < Base
        include Parentheses
        extend AutoCorrector

        ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[and or send splat kwsplat].freeze

        # @!method square_brackets?(node)
        def_node_matcher :square_brackets?, '(send {(send _recv _msg) str array hash} :[] ...)'

        # @!method method_node_and_args(node)
        def_node_matcher :method_node_and_args, '$(call _recv _msg $...)'

        # @!method rescue?(node)
        def_node_matcher :rescue?, '{^resbody ^^resbody}'

        # @!method allowed_pin_operator?(node)
        def_node_matcher :allowed_pin_operator?, '^(pin (begin !{lvar ivar cvar gvar}))'

        def on_begin(node)
          return if !parentheses?(node) || parens_allowed?(node) || ignore_syntax?(node)

          check(node)
        end

        private

        def parens_allowed?(node)
          empty_parentheses?(node) ||
            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node)
        end

        def ignore_syntax?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.while_post_type? || parent.until_post_type? || parent.match_with_lvasgn_type? ||
            like_method_argument_parentheses?(parent) || multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
        end

        def allowed_expression?(node)
          allowed_ancestor?(node) ||
            allowed_multiple_expression?(node) ||
            allowed_ternary?(node) ||
            node.parent&.range_type?
        end

        def allowed_ancestor?(node)
          # Don't flag `break(1)`, etc
          keyword_ancestor?(node) && parens_required?(node)

Implemented the fix in `lib/rubocop/cop/style/redundant_parentheses.rb`.

The cop now skips parentheses around a method chain containing a `do...end` block when the parenthesized expression is itself an argument, preserving evaluation order. Brace-block cases still register offenses as expected.
